note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative: the word is generic and fictional, the definition and the clause are placeholders, never real contract text; times are fictional labels. "Defined term" and "term with no linked definition" are supplied, neutral configurations of equal weight: they only say where each supplied scenario shows the definition slip (in the contract's dock, where a thread then links the word to it once the contract is unfolded, or still in the definitions sheet's dock). No interpretation rule (no contra proferentem, no plain meaning, no canon of construction), no conclusion about what the word means, no winner and no jurisdiction is stated. Brief customizable fields not exposed (coordinator decision BRIEF CUSTOMIZABLE FIELDS, SESSION_HANDOFF 2026-10-05): the clauses list (one clause: term.clause), schedules, the definitions list (one definition slip: definition) and priorities. The item exposes the parties, the definitions sheet, its single definition slip, the contract, the word and its clause, both scenarios' sequences and configurations, the changed and shared facts and the comparison labels.

Coordinator decision (standing stress cap rule, AUTHORING item 20, 2026-09-26): sharedFacts is capped from two items to one (count still ≥ the baseline, which has none; the remaining fact keeps its 51 characters). TRUE driver: 1:1 with labels shown — with two shared facts ("Same parties, the same documents and the same word", "Same sequence of journeys in both scenes") the right-hand column (comparison table + notes) no longer fits beside the stacked stages at 16.1 px with the bars2 documents, and the search falls to the collapse-and-fade layout whose stages leave the frame at the guide (rendered: 0 of 4 people visible from u 0.8). Tried and not sufficient on their own: the word, clause and definition at baseline length, the neutral note at 42 characters, a shorter guide, the changed fact at 32 characters, two shorter shared facts (all still collapse). With one shared fact 1:1 keeps the right-hand column (16.1 px, 55.2 model px heads); 16:9 and 9:16 fit the pre-cap values (16.1 px, 57.7 model px heads).
